text: ＊の　＊が　がくっと　さがった！

patterns.name: 〜と (sound word)
patterns.span: がくっと　さがった
patterns.explanation: と after a sound-effect word ties it to the action and tells you in what way the action happens. がくっと　さがった = 'fell with a sudden drop'.

patterns.name: 〜た
patterns.explanation: た on the end of a verb says the thing has already happened. さがった = 'fell'.
